name: Pump kitchen
note: The prices is depends on what you will order from menu or from the build your own bowl
description: Pump Kitchen is Bali's ultimate dining hotspot for fitness enthusiasts, gym-goers, and anyone focused on maintaining a clean, macro-tracked diet. Located in the trendy area of Pererenan, it specializes in premium high-protein, calorie-conscious meals and customizable clean bowls that prove healthy eating can still taste incredible.
